description: Triage every agent thread at a glance: what needs you, what's working and what's done. A feed at the top quotes each question, approval and failure waiting on you, above a project tree that holds still while you read. Subagents and hidden workflow workers nest under the thread that started them, and a Crew panel maps every worktree they touch. Pull requests read in words on their row, such as checks failed or ready to merge. Needs bb 0.46 or later; optional AI titles run on your own Claude Code or Codex CLI, and optional sharper states need a TypeSafe API key.
